name: terraform-multicloud-orchestrator
description: Plan-only Terraform authoring companion for Azure. Designs module and state boundaries, applies Azure naming, identity, networking and secure-by-default baselines, checks arguments against the pinned azurerm version, audits code against its standard and against azurerm 5 with a read-only script, explains failed plans and applies, and validates with plan-only commands; never runs apply or destroy.
